## UML Testing Profile (UTP) Test Suite for U08_Alarms

**Test Suite Name:** U08_Alarms_TestSuite

**Test Suite Description:** This test suite verifies the functionality of the alarms in the respiratory support system.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Low pressure alarm
- Pressure high alarm
- PIP too high alarm

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- The respiratory support system is powered on.
- The patient is connected to the system.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- All alarms are in the expected state.

Manually trigger 3 consecutive breaths above threshold. 3.
